title: page renderer: a ${…} hole inside an inline locale map reaches the block raw, so an authored localized string that carries a bound value shows the template text
body:
Filing gate ①: class (c), a metadata trap: a stored page's localized copy that the runtime silently does not evaluate. Filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from the os-dev report on objectstack-ai/cloud#2986 (PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2993). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens (objectui `c4dd7078ed`, the objectui#12197 landing)

A page node's `properties` value is evaluated per value, shallowly.
- `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx:646`: `isDataObjectValue` hands any object without a dialect over as authored. That includes an inline locale map such as `{ zh: '最近发布 ${data.environments[0].lastPublishedAt}', en: 'Published ${…}' }`. The docblock above it says so: "a template nested inside a data object stays raw".
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/blocks/productBlocks.tsx:133-134`: the `hero` block resolves `title` / `subtitle` with `pickLocalized`, so the chosen locale's string arrives with `${…}` unevaluated and is drawn as text.
- A plain string with the same hole is evaluated. A locale map, which is the shape every localized page copy takes, is not.

**Why it is a trap.** An author writes localized copy with a bound value, the page saves and validates, and the screen shows `最近发布 ${data…}`. Nothing refuses it at save, and nothing warns.

## Reach

- **objectstack-ai/cloud#2986:** the cloud home's hero line 「最近发布 10月16日 · 免费版 · 1 / 1 个生产环境」 (the CloudHome artboard) cannot be drawn, so PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2993 ships without it, and a localized word beside a bound number has to be split into two nodes.
- Any SDUI page author writing localized copy with a hole: this repository's own pages and AI-built pages alike.

## Wanted (this lane picks the shape)

1. A `${…}` hole inside each member of an inline locale map is evaluated against the node's scope, the same as a plain string on the same key (`record`, `page`, `current_user`, and `data` under an API binding).
2. Or, if the lane rules that locale maps never carry holes, the save path refuses such a value loudly (publish-time), so it is never silently drawn raw.
3. Tests: a hero `title` locale map with a `data.*` hole renders the bound value in zh and en; a non-hole locale map is unchanged (control).

## Dedupe

REST enumeration of this repository's issues since 2026-09-20 (135), grepped for `locale map`, `inline locale`, `localized … hole`, `template … locale`, `unevaluated`:
- #12757 (closed): an action's `I18nLabel` locale maps reached `ActionRunner` unresolved, as objects. That is a different site and mechanism (no holes).
- #12838 (closed): aria-label templates shipping English words. A different defect.
